title: I-033 approval, budget reservation, and idempotent posting
clauseOfficialized: The same idempotency key causes at most one provider POST. An unknown provider status is not blindly retried (UNKNOWN_NO_BLIND_RETRY; poll does not POST). A late cancel only settles or releases and does not attach to the timeline; a late cancel after a settled post does not append. Fee, upload, and portrait consents cannot be waived by a license warning (WARNING_DOES_NOT_EXEMPT, postCount=0). A binding change invalidates approval (APPROVAL_STALE) and does not auto-increase budget; exhaustion pauses with BUDGET_EXHAUSTED.
whyNotAlreadyOfficial: I-033 was planned with no approval/budget/reconcile implementation in studio_harness.
rowsStillOpenOnI033: I-003 project-store persistence of receipts/outbox (in-memory only in this slice)
